verdict.rationale: mise is a CLI-only tool with no separate GUI, so every capability is already exposed through its scriptable, documented command surface. That surface includes tools, env, tasks, config and bootstrap, with flags such as -C, --dry-run and --json. An official `mise mcp` server also gives AI assistants a programmatic interface to read tools, tasks, env and config and to run tasks. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of interface parity, MCP coverage of mutating operations like install/use (it only reads state and runs tasks), structured JSON output documented across commands beyond isolated examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use.
